create_eval_runner: create an EvalRunner instance with an agent population, environment names, and episode count for evaluation
run_eval_rollout: run the EvalRunner to rollout agents across all environments and collect evaluation statistics
generate_kwargs_combos: generate all combinations of keyword argument choices from a dictionary of argument options
create_envs_for_kwargs: create environment info tuples by expanding environment names with all kwargs combinations
load_checkpoint_state: load a checkpoint state dictionary into the runner state for agent population restoration
